text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A fan letter arrived for Daiwa Scarlet.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
H-Huh~
Fan mail arrived for me, you say. I see.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
H-Hmph! If anything, someone like me
deserves to be getting a whole lot more!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
If I'm aiming for number one,
I can't act like a baby over something like this--

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm not smirking!
Come on, let's hurry up and get to training!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...I'll prove I can live up to it.
To everyone's expectations of me—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Daiwa Scarlet spent that entire day
working hard on her training, looking cheerful throughout.
